text: To illustrate this, consider the schema in_dep (ID, name, salary, dept_name, building, budget) that we decomposed in Section 7.1 into the instructor and department schemas: instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) department (dept_name, building, budget) Consider the intersection of these two schemas, which is dept_name. We see that be- cause dept_name— dept_name, building, budget, the lossless-decomposition rule is sat- isfied.
